lines.vo: Some gym members paid over seventeen dollars a visit, when a ten dollar pass was right there.
That's not bad math. That's overconfidence.
They studied nearly eight thousand members at three American gyms.
People on monthly plans went so rarely that each visit cost them more than seventeen dollars on average.
They expected to go way more often than they really did.
Paying for the gym doesn't get you there. Planning does.
So Dre schedules his visits in his Fit and Strong Tracker and checks off each one.
